customerOutcome: Manage company identity and set the English/Danish language fallback and IANA timezone used for newly created company schedules.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and selected company; current company membership and role are rechecked for locale/timezone changes.
Existing CEO permissions for company branding do not grant authority to change company defaults.
exitConditions: Persist company identity and defaults through the canonical Company writer, or preserve entered values and report a validation, permission or system error.
New schedules inherit the company timezone only when the Routine writer receives no explicit timezone; existing schedules are not rewritten.

content.supportingCopy: Company language is the fallback when a member has no personal language preference; company timezone is the default for new schedules that omit a timezone. Existing schedules and explicit account preferences remain unchanged.
displayedState: Company name and description, with current persisted values prefilled
Company default language (English or Danish) and timezone (IANA timezone identifier)
Appearance, new-hire approval and interaction resolver settings remain in their existing sections

inputs.label: Organization name
inputs.help: The display name for the selected company.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.help: Optional description shown in the company profile.
inputs.validation: Nullable text accepted by the Company API.

inputs.label: Default language
inputs.default: Current company locale; en for legacy rows
inputs.help: Used when a member has no personal language preference; does not replace an explicit account preference.
inputs.validation: Only en and da are accepted by the Company API.

inputs.label: Default timezone
inputs.default: Current company timezone; UTC for legacy rows
inputs.help: Used for new schedules only when a caller omits a timezone. Existing schedules keep their own timezone.
inputs.validation: Must be accepted by the runtime's IANA timezone database.

primary.label: Save changes
primary.operation: PATCH the selected company through the existing Company writer; current owner/administrator membership is required for locale/timezone changes.

secondary: Save the locale and timezone together with the other General changes.
Correct an invalid timezone or refresh company authority before retrying.

canonicalReadDomains: Current authenticated company membership and role
Current Company identity, locale and timezone
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Company identity/default mutations only through the existing Company writer; new schedule timezone fallback resolves in the existing Routine writer
systemWork.authorityEffect: The settings screen grants no authority. Locale/timezone writes require current owner/administrator membership; CEO-safe branding permissions do not extend to those defaults.
systemWork.asyncWork: The Company route validates locale/timezone, rechecks the current actor and company scope, then persists through the existing Company service.
systemWork.receipt: Company changes are shown from the persisted Company response; a newly created schedule stores the explicit timezone or the company default resolved by the Routine writer.

states.loading: Keep controls associated with the selected company while its current values load.
states.empty: No selected company is available; do not show another company's settings.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Do not save values for a prior company after selection changes; refresh values from the current company response.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Withhold changes that the current actor cannot make; do not infer write authority from the selected company alone.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Show company defaults from the persisted Company response. Do not imply that changing the company timezone rewrites existing schedules or that changing company language overwrites personal language preferences.

navigation.back: Return to Company through the current company route.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Keep unsaved values local; discard them when the user changes company or leaves settings.
navigation.resume: Reload current company values; never replay a prior mutation automatically.

accessibility.initialFocus: Focus the Company page heading after the current authorized read; a category hash deep link moves focus to that category heading.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Keep focus at the General section and make the saved state available to assistive technology.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Company identity and locale/timezone defaults returned by the Company API.
dataCollected: Company name, description, language and timezone are written by the existing Company owner; standard company.updated audit activity records changed fields.
sensitiveFields: Membership, role, configuration, provider, security metadata and source references remain in their Original owner.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Use the existing Company audit event for changed fields; do not add credentials, unrelated account data or raw validation errors to logs.

functional: On the exact artifact, verify the General category keeps its stable label and exposes the Company writer's identity, language and timezone controls.
Verify only English and Danish are accepted, invalid IANA timezones are rejected, and unauthorized members cannot change company defaults.
Verify account language preferences and existing schedule timezones remain unchanged, while newly created schedules inherit the company timezone only when their caller omits a timezone.
Verify account/company switching and permission withdrawal remove prior private entries before a late response can restore them.
accessibility: Verify keyboard navigation, focus order, screen-reader names/status and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact; this contract is not conformance evidence.
securityPrivacy: Verify current company owner/administrator authorization, cross-tenant refusal, and no configuration writes from unauthorized members.
usability: Run representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory setting journeys for the exact artifact, including empty, restricted and unavailable states; source checks alone do not qualify usability.
